name: finch-feishu-bot
description: Connect Feishu Bot to Finch with streaming message cards and inbox sessions.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=es2022 --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'; import { dirname } from 'node:path'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = dirname(__filename);" --outfile=dist/index.js
